title: FloodPay Schedule of Depth Bands and Payout Amounts
content:
FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines) pays a pre-agreed amount when the depth sensor at the insured location measures flood water reaching a trigger band. The schedule below sets, for every FloodPay tier, the payout limit, the depth at which each band is reached, the share of the payout limit each band pays, the window that groups readings into one flood event and the number of payouts one flood event can produce.

## Schedule

| Tier | Payout limit (USD) | Band 1 depth (inches) | Band 2 depth (inches) | Band 3 depth (inches) | Band 1 pays (% of limit) | Band 2 pays (% of limit) | Band 3 pays (% of limit) | Flood event window (elapsed hours) | Payouts per flood event |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 5000 | 2 | 12 | 24 | 25 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 10000 | 2 | 12 | 24 | 25 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 25000 | 2 | 12 | 24 | 25 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 50000 | 2 | 12 | 24 | 25 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 100000 | 2 | 12 | 24 | 25 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 250000 | 4 | 12 | 24 | 20 | 60 | 100 | 72 | 1 |

## Meaning of the columns

- **Payout limit** — the payout for a full-band event, in US dollars.
- **Band 1, band 2 and band 3 depth** — the measured depth, in inches, that triggers each band; band 3 is the full-payout band.
- **Band 1, band 2 and band 3 pays** — the payout for that band, stated as a percent of the payout limit.
- **Flood event window** — the window, in elapsed hours, within which all readings belong to one flood event.
- **Payouts per flood event** — the number of payouts one flood event can produce.

## Notes on the tiers

- The three FloodPay Home tiers and the FloodPay Business 50K and 100K tiers share one band structure: band 1 at 2 inches paying 25 percent, band 2 at 12 inches paying 60 percent, band 3 at 24 inches paying 100 percent.
- FloodPay Business 250K starts band 1 at 4 inches rather than 2 and pays 20 percent rather than 25 percent at band 1; its band 2 and band 3 depths and percentages are the same as the other tiers.
- Every tier groups readings into flood events over 72 elapsed hours and allows 1 payout per flood event.

## Band amounts in dollars

Each band's dollar amount is the band's percent multiplied by the tier's payout limit:

| Tier | Band 1 (USD) | Band 2 (USD) | Band 3 (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 1,250 | 3,000 | 5,000 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 2,500 | 6,000 | 10,000 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 6,250 | 15,000 | 25,000 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 12,500 | 30,000 | 50,000 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 25,000 | 60,000 | 100,000 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 50,000 | 150,000 | 250,000 |
